text: こった　ニックネームも　いいが　おぼえやすいのが　いちばん　やな！

structure.jp: こった　ニックネームも　いいが
structure.en: elaborate nicknames are nice too, but
ones that are easy to remember

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means 'easy to do'. おぼえやすい = 'easy to remember'.

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の after a describing word stands in for a thing already mentioned, like 'one' in English; here it means a nickname. おぼえやすいの = 'an easy-to-remember one'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: や is the Kansai dialect form of だ, 'is', and な is like ね. いちばん　やな = 'is the best, yeah'.
